Class Shop

java.lang.Object
Item_Classes.Shop
public class Shop extends Object
Manages item offerings, dynamic menu rendering, and purchasing logic in Hanamaru's Store. Handles store availability, item unlocking based on rescued NPCs, and player transactions.
